title: Beyond the 956: Cocoa Woman Charged With Attempted Murder After Allegedly Tracking Boyfriend and Shooting Woman in Car
excerpt: Katherine Dale Kelly, 24, of Cocoa, Florida, was charged with attempted first-degree murder after authorities say she tracked her boyfriend's car to Port St. John, took an Uber to the location, and fired into the vehicle, striking the woman in the passenger seat in the shoulder.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

A Cocoa, Florida, woman was charged with attempted first-degree murder after authorities say she tracked her boyfriend's car, took an Uber to where it was parked, and fired a shot into the vehicle, striking the woman sitting in the passenger seat in the shoulder.

Katherine Dale Kelly, 24, of Cocoa, was charged after the early Saturday, October 24, shooting in Port St. John, according to Florida Today, citing an arrest affidavit. She also faces charges of aggravated battery with a weapon and shooting into a vehicle, according to inmate records cited in news reports.

According to the affidavit, Kelly's boyfriend, Elijah Baker, had taken her Volkswagen without her permission in the early morning hours of October 24. Kelly tracked the car's location, put her pink-and-black Glock pistol in her purse, and took an Uber to the area where she believed Baker was, Florida Today reported.

She found the car in a grassy field off Bamboo Avenue, where Baker was parked with another woman, according to the affidavit. Kelly walked to the passenger side and fired one round, striking the woman in the left shoulder, Florida Today reported. The woman was later treated at Holmes Regional Medical Center.

Investigators say Kelly had texted Baker earlier about her suspicions that he was cheating on her and had threatened to shoot someone, according to the police report. Kelly first told investigators she acted in self-defense, but later told them she fired to "make a point" about Baker's cheating, authorities said.

Kelly remains held at the Brevard County Jail without bond, Florida Today reported. Her arraignment is scheduled for November 24 at the Viera Courthouse. Baker has not been charged with a crime.

The charges against Kelly are allegations, and she is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) Instagram post; Florida Today; New York Post.
